name: Strawberry festival (China)
when: greenhouse picking from winter to May around Beijing; the Changping strawberry carnival ran 17 March to 13 May in 2018
summary: Strawberry picking and strawberry carnivals, around Beijing (Changping) in spring and in the Dandong area from late autumn.
details: Changping district north of Beijing holds a strawberry carnival at its Strawberry Expo Park each spring (17 March to 13 May in 2018), and picking farms there run from about April to May. Dandong in Liaoning is a large growing base: the harvest starts around November and sales peak around February. No fixed festival date was found; dates change each year, so check the district or tourism site.

highlights.name: Dandong (Donggang) strawberries
highlights.note: Main growing base; harvest from about November, peak sales around February.
